notes.title: Small game balance update.
notes.content:
Hello pilots!

I've made some adjustments that should improve the gaming experience.

Mainly Mission 28 (the first mission with the jet) was adapted.
The firing interval of most guns has been extended and you now have more time to fly through the tunnels. I also placed a fuel item halfway.

The fuel consumption of all planes has been reduced, which should make the game easier, especially at the beginning when no upgrades have been installed yet.

Some projectiles and missiles now deal less damage.

Have fun!

notes.title: New game balance
notes.content:
Hello pilots.

I got a lot of feedback that Cavatus is a bit too difficult.
That's why I made extensive adjustments.

The difficulty went down about one level.
It can be said that the old easy is now the new normal.

[h2]What has changed:[/h2]

The enemies are easier to destroy and do less damage themselves.

In addition, the maximum damage you take in a collision has been reduced by 20%.

The damage from landing hard on the runway has also been reduced.
(Only on normal and hard. On Easy there is still no damage)

[h2]What hasn't changed:[/h2]

The amount of fuel, fuel consumption, hitpoints and firepower.
Because these are gameplay things and you should collect the upgrades to improve these values. 

Of course I tested the new balance and I can definitely say that you will feel the changes. :)

Have fun!

notes.title: Game balance.
notes.content:
Hi!
I adjusted some values to make the game a bit easier.
The changes apply to all modes but most changes have been made in easy mode.

- Enemy buildings now have fewer hitpoints.
- Enemy projectiles now do less damage.

Have fun!
